categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly formatted with AI crawler directives
Sitemap auto-generated with 17 correct canonical URLs
trailingSlash:never prevents duplicate URL variants
Zero-JS static HTML, fully crawlable
HTTPS enforced site-wide
404 page returns noindex with useful nav links

findings.title: Sitemap missing lastmod/priority/changefreq
findings.description: sitemap-index.xml and sitemap-0.xml lack date and priority metadata. Google uses these signals to prioritize crawling and freshness evaluation.
findings.recommendation: Customize @astrojs/sitemap with serialize option to inject lastmod dates and priority values per URL pattern.

findings.title: Custom meta date tags not recognized by Google
findings.description: meta[name=datePublished] and meta[name=dateModified] are custom attributes that Googlebot ignores. Dates must be in structured data or visible page text.
findings.recommendation: Move datePublished/dateModified into JSON-LD schema blocks or ensure visible 'Last updated' text exists.

findings.title: Organization.sameAs links are reference pages not social profiles
findings.description: sameAs array contains TripAdvisor, Wikidata, Wikipedia URLs which are third-party reference pages, not the brand's official social media profiles.
findings.recommendation: Replace with actual social profiles or remove sameAs if none exist.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 25+ content modules covering all traveler needs
Strong E-E-A-T signals: team visit badge, Person schema, 200+ days in Yunnan
Comprehensive FAQ (18 questions with detailed answers)
Practical planning tools: itineraries, weather table, altitude guide
First-hand experience markers throughout

findings.title: No user engagement mechanism (comments/reviews)
findings.description: Competitor Fabio Nodari has 18+ real comments building social proof and user engagement signals. Comments are a Google ranking signal for informational content.
findings.recommendation: Add Giscus (GitHub Discussions-based, no tracking) or Disqus commenting system.

findings.title: No visible author byline despite Person schema
findings.description: Person schema exists in JSON-LD but user cannot see author credentials, reducing perceived E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add short 'Written by Shangri-La Guide Team, 200+ days in Yunnan' line near hero or About page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tag: 43 chars with year and primary keyword
Meta description: 154 chars, compelling with selling points
Single h1 with clear keyword targeting
Clean heading hierarchy (h1 → 16 h2s, no skips)
Canonical URLs correct on all 17 pages
hreflang=x-default set to English
Internal link matrix (16 links) covering all sections

findings.title: BreadcrumbList schema without visible breadcrumb UI
findings.description: JSON-LD BreadcrumbList exists but users see no breadcrumb navigation. Google may flag schema/page mismatch or ignore the breadcrumb markup.
findings.recommendation: Add visible breadcrumb component or remove unused schema.

findings.title: Sub-pages lack h2 section headings
findings.description: Attraction and food pages only have h1 (item name). Well-structured h2s would improve on-page SEO signals.
findings.recommendation: Add h2 subsections (Overview, Getting There, Tips) to sub-page templates.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 6 distinct schema types on homepage (WebPage, BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, TouristDestination, ItemList)
Person schema on About page with knowsAbout and affiliation
All JSON-LD valid with no syntax errors
FAQ answers are substantive (3-5 sentences each)
TouristDestination includes geo coordinates

findings.title: Schemas not consolidated with @graph
findings.description: Multiple separate script[type=ld+json] blocks instead of single @graph array. Both work but @graph is cleaner.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate all page schemas into one @graph array.

findings.title: Attraction sub-pages lack TouristAttraction schema
findings.description: 9 attraction detail pages have no page-specific structured data beyond BaseLayout defaults. TouristAttraction schema enables rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add TouristAttraction JSON-LD with geo, photo, opening hours to each attraction page.

findings.title: Food sub-pages lack Recipe/FoodEstablishment schema
findings.description: 6 food pages could benefit from structured data for food-related rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add food schema or merge food content into homepage to consolidate authority.

categories.name: Performance / Core Web Vitals
what_works: Static HTML, zero client JS
Hero image uses fetchpriority='high'
WebP format for 20/21 images
Explicit width/height on all images for CLS prevention

findings.title: 2.34 MB PNG image destroys LCP
findings.description: snub-nosed-monkey.png is 2.34 MB. Converting to WebP at quality 80 would yield ~180 KB — a 92% reduction.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP immediately using sharp or ImageMagick.

findings.title: Google Fonts blocks text rendering
findings.description: External fonts.googleapis.com CSS blocks first text paint. Font download adds ~200ms to FCP on slow connections.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Outfit font files with font-display:swap.

findings.title: No decoding='async' on lazy images
findings.description: Images with loading='lazy' still decode on main thread. decoding='async' offloads decode work.
findings.recommendation: Add decoding='async' to all lazy-loaded img tags.

findings.title: CSS bundles are separate requests
findings.description: Two CSS files (~46 KB total) generate two network requests. Inlining critical above-fold CSS would improve FCP.
findings.recommendation: Use Astro's is:inline for above-fold CSS.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers (GPTBot, Claude-Web, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot) explicitly allowed
All content static HTML — no JS rendering needed
FAQ schema provides structured Q&A for AI extraction
Comprehensive content depth signals increase citation likelihood

findings.title: No llms.txt for AI crawler discovery
findings.description: llms.txt is the emerging standard for AI crawler content indexing. Without it, AI crawlers discover pages through normal crawling which may miss key content.
findings.recommendation: Create llms.txt at root listing key pages with descriptions per llmstxt.org spec.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt for AI training datasets
findings.description: Full-text markdown export enables AI models to use content in training data with proper attribution.
findings.recommendation: Generate llms-full.txt with all page content in markdown format.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 20/21 images in WebP format
Descriptive alt text (12-18 words) on all images
loading='lazy' on below-fold images
fetchpriority='high' on hero image

findings.title: 1 PNG image (2.34 MB) among all-WebP site
findings.description: snub-nosed-monkey.png is the sole PNG in a WebP-optimized site. 92% reducible.

findings.title: No responsive srcset for images
findings.description: All users download full-size images regardless of viewport. Mobile users on 3G pay for desktop-size images.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with 400w/800w/1200w variants using Astro Image or picture elements.
